tx-ap201.form_seen: AP-201 Texas Application for Sales and Use Tax Permit (eSystems online, or paper AP-201)

fields.zh: 独资业主的社会安全号

fields.en: Each partner's SSN or federal EIN

fields.en: Texas Secretary of State file number (corporations and LLCs)
fields.zh: 德州州务卿档案号（公司及 LLC）

fields.en: SSN for each officer or director (or the paper AP-201 if they have none)
fields.zh: 各高管或董事的 SSN（如无 SSN，使用纸质 AP-201）

destination.evidence: Paper AP-201 is required if you are a sole owner, partner, officer or director without a Social Security number: email it to sales.applications@cpa.texas.gov or fax it to 512-936-0010.

tx-ap201.notes: Chinese owners without an SSN must use the paper AP-201 by email or fax; everyone else applies online in eSystems. No fee stated; allow 2 to 3 weeks.
